analysis.title: S&P Global Inc. (SPGI): 3Q First Take: Revenue and margins surpass expectations with the full year outlook increased
key_insights: SPGI 3Q26 total revenue was $3,678mn, up 6.8% y/y (7.1% organic constant currency), versus GS estimate of 5.6% growth and FactSet consensus of 5.8%. Energy, Indices and Market Intelligence beat, Ratings fell modestly short.
Operating margin expanded 60 bps y/y to 53.5%, versus GS estimate of 51.6% and consensus of 52.6%, driven by higher-margin revenue mix and operating leverage.
3Q26 EPS was $4.58, versus GS estimate of $4.39 and consensus of $4.43.

Ratings revenue grew 2.5% y/y, below GS forecast of 3.3%. Transaction revenue grew 1%, with investment grade strength from hyperscaler deals and M&A offset by softness in high yield, bank loans and structured finance. Non-transaction revenue grew 4%. Global rated debt issuance grew 4% y/y in 3Q.
Non-Ratings businesses, about 65% of revenue, grew 9% y/y. Indices grew 19.9% (GS est 17.0%), Market Intelligence 6.8% (GS est 4.6%), and Energy 5.9% (GS est 3.0%).
SPGI raised 2026 organic constant currency revenue growth guidance from 6.0-8.0% to 7.5-8.5%, and reported revenue growth guidance from 5.9-7.9% to 7.4-8.4%.
2026 operating margin expansion guidance was raised from 35-60 bps (75-100 bps ex OSTTRA) to 75-100 bps (125-150 bps ex OSTTRA). 2026 EPS guidance was raised from $17.50-17.75 to $17.70-17.95.
Segment guidance: Ratings raised to 6.5-8.0% (from 5.0-8.0%), Indices raised to 17.0-18.5% (from 12-14%), Market Intelligence unchanged at 5.5-7.0%, Energy unchanged at 4.5-6.0%.

GS says guidance points to negative consensus revisions for revenue, positive revisions for operating margins and largely stable consensus EPS. Pre-print GS 2026 estimates were revenue growth 7.4%, margin 52.0%, EPS $17.77. FactSet consensus was revenue growth 9.1%, margin 51.4%, EPS $17.84.

GS reiterates Buy with a 12-month price target of $519, based on 23.5x NTM + 1YR EPS of $22.09, a premium to the Info Services peer median of 16.5x. The stock closed at $450.65 on 26 Oct 2026, implying 15.2% upside.

GS expects earnings call focus on management's latest view of debt issuance growth and drivers for the rest of 2026 and 2027, the competitive and selling environment for Market Intelligence, portfolio considerations for Market Intelligence, and progress monetizing AI capabilities.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 revenue, margin and EPS beat consensus and full-year guidance was raised. GS expects a positive investor reaction.

earnings_insights: SPGI 3Q26 (reported 10/27): revenue $3,678mn reported vs GS est $3,636mn and FactSet consensus est $3,643mn. Growth 6.8% y/y vs GS est 5.6% and consensus est 5.8%.
SPGI 3Q26 EPS $4.58 reported vs GS est $4.39 and FactSet consensus est $4.43. The report does not label the EPS as adjusted or GAAP.
SPGI 3Q26 operating profit $1,969mn reported vs GS est $1,874mn and consensus est $1,916mn. Operating margin 53.5% vs GS est 51.6% and consensus est 52.6%.

SPGI 3Q26 segment revenue: Ratings $1,271mn (GS est $1,281mn, consensus est $1,276mn), Market Intelligence $1,263mn (GS est $1,293mn, consensus est $1,253mn), Energy $645mn (GS est $573mn, consensus est $633mn), Indices $554mn (GS est $541mn, consensus est $539mn).
SPGI 2026 company guidance raised: EPS $17.70-17.95 (prior $17.50-17.75), OCC revenue growth 7.5-8.5% (prior 6.0-8.0%), operating margin expansion 75-100 bps (prior 35-60 bps).

GS pre-print 2026 estimates: revenue growth 7.4%, operating margin 52.0%, EPS $17.77. FactSet consensus: revenue growth 9.1%, operating margin 51.4%, EPS $17.84. GS full-year forecasts: 2026E EPS $17.77, 2027E $20.53, 2028E $23.64.
risk_factors: Moderation in debt issuance volume growth.
Financial services budget and headcount pressures that could weigh on Market Intelligence growth.
A market pull-back that could pressure Indices growth.
